label: VERIFIED
extraction: Veritas Kanban model transparency and squad chat protocol. All agents (PM and workers) must post to squad chat (glass box transparency). PM logs spawn events with model; workers post progress with model identifier. --model flag shows which AI model behind each agent in squad chat UI. PM responsibilities: before spawning each worker, log spawn event with model; when worker fails, log failure; coordination updates as regular messages. Worker responsibilities: post progress throughout work including model identifier. Scripts: squad-event.sh for spawn/fail events, squad-post.sh for progress updates. Example: Opus PM orchestrating Codex workers - Opus reads sprint tasks, assigns to self and Codex, spawns Codex worker with managed-run handoff template.
